title: Running only to the familiar bush
literal_meaning: The lizard’s dash is to the siju bush!
explanation: The source uses the short dash to mock a narrow range of thought. Much motion may still lead only to a familiar answer.
meaning_odia: ବହୁତ ହଲଚଲ ଥିଲେ ବି ଶେଷରେ ଚିନ୍ତା ସେହି ଛୋଟ ପରିସରରେ ଅଟକି ରହୁଛି। ଏଣ୍ଡୁଅ ଓ ସିଜୁବୁଦାର ଚିତ୍ରରେ ଏହି ସୀମିତ ଘୂରଣକୁ ଦେଖାଯାଇଛି। ବ୍ୟସ୍ତ ରହିବା ଓ ଦୃଷ୍ଟିକୋଣ ବଢ଼ିବା ଏକ ନୁହେଁ; ଏହାକୁ କାହାର ଜନ୍ମଗତ ବୁଦ୍ଧିର ମାପ ବୋଲି ନେବା ଉଚିତ ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: A planning group holds many meetings but considers only the same old option. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: Siju is retained as the plant name. This is a figurative reading, not a zoological claim or a judgment of fixed intelligence.

graphic.alt: A small lizard follows a short curved track toward a bush.
graphic.caption: Much motion, the same familiar destination. The bush is an illustrative stand-in, not a botanical depiction of siju.

odia_summary: ବହୁତ ଧାଁଧପଡ଼ କଲେ ବି ଚିନ୍ତା ସେହି ସୀମିତ ଗଣ୍ଡି ଭିତରେ ରହିଯାଏ।
english_summary: Much activity can still end within the same narrow circle of thought.
